description: Run the deterministic floors (coverage, SAST, secrets, deps, a11y, perf) and record results in a proof pack.

check.description: Only the behaviour floor, on these feature-map checks: <feature>, <feature>.<check>, or all (the sweep); a run outside the merge gate is a preview.

maintain.description: With --map or --check: post the maintain brief on the tracking issue for the agent app [verify] maintainer names, when the map drifted or a check failed (drift), or every time (always).

map.description: Only the feature-map drift check (WP4.5b): compare every .agents/skills/verify-*/ map with the source, run nothing, and exit 3 on drift.

pr.description: Pull request to verify; defaults to the current worktree.

security.description: Only the security floors (sast, secrets, deps) on the checked-out commit, with no PR or story: what aayudha-security.yml runs on every push and nightly. With --ci, each failing finding files or updates one aayudha:security Bug.

since.description: With --security: scan secrets only in the commits after this revision (a push's before); without it, or with all zeros or an unknown revision, the whole history of HEAD.
